fields.name: jcr:title
fields.label: Page Title
fields.description: Shown as the tab name and as the headline in Google results. Aim for under 60 characters — Google truncates past that. Put the distinctive words first; every page needs its own.

fields.name: jcr:description
fields.label: Meta Description
fields.description: The grey summary under the link in Google results, and the text shown when the page is shared. Aim for 120-160 characters — under 50 is too thin to be useful, over 160 gets cut off mid-sentence. Write a sentence that would make someone click, not a list of keywords.

fields.name: keywords
fields.label: Keywords
fields.description: Used by this site's own search, not by Google — search engines have ignored this tag for years. Add the words a visitor might type to find this page.

fields.name: og:image
fields.label: Social Share Image
fields.description: The picture shown when this page is shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, X or in a text message. Use 1200x630. If left empty the first image on the page is used, which is often a cropped or decorative one — set it deliberately on any page you expect to be shared. (Alt text for this image cannot be set here: og:image:alt needs two colons and an AEM property name allows only one. It is set in the bulk metadata sheet instead — see docs/seo-and-social.md.)

fields.name: og:title
fields.label: Social Share Title (optional)
fields.description: Overrides the Page Title when shared on social media. Leave empty to reuse the Page Title. Worth setting when the SEO title is keyword-led but the shareable version should be more human.

fields.name: og:description
fields.label: Social Share Description (optional)
fields.description: Overrides the Meta Description when shared on social media. Leave empty to reuse it.

fields.name: og:type
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: How social platforms categorise this page. Use Article for news, blog posts and dated content; Website for everything else.

fields.name: og:locale
fields.label: Language
fields.description: The language of this page, for social platforms. Set to Spanish on pages under /es.

fields.name: robots
fields.label: Search Engine Visibility
fields.description: Leave as Index unless there is a reason not to. Choose No Index for thank-you pages, internal test pages and anything duplicated elsewhere — it removes the page from Google without unpublishing it.

options.name: No Index — hide from search results

fields.name: canonical
fields.label: Canonical URL (optional)
fields.description: Only needed when this page duplicates another. Point it at the version that should rank, so the two do not compete with each other in search. Leave empty otherwise — the page's own URL is used.

fields.name: blog-newsletter-source-path
fields.label: Blog Newsletter Source Path
fields.description: Optional. Blog pages render Newsletter blocks from the first Newsletter block on this source page. Use local, none, off, or false to disable on a specific page.
